{{Top|leg|canon=Trophy Chase}}
The '''trophy chase''' was a violent sport played on [[Dalos IV]]. It was popular and attracted tourists to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] every year. The trophy chase was played from the backs of immature [[neph]]s, and players used [[repulsor-stick]]s to propel an [[anti-grav ball]] into [[target-ring]]s suspended from a stable neph. [[Goal-judge]]s served as referees for the sport.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
